mapper.sql: SELECT a.id AS account_id, i.ticker AS symbol, SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN t.execution_quantity ELSE -t.execution_quantity END) AS net_quantity, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN t.execution_quantity ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN t.execution_quantity * t.execution_price ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN t.execution_quantity ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END AS average_cost FROM Trades t JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN Instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE a.id = #{accountId}
mapper.select: GROUP BY a.id, i.ticker HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN t.execution_quantity ELSE -t.execution_quantity END) <> 0 ORDER BY i.ticker
SELECT quantity, average_price, market_value, unrealized_pnl_value FROM Positions_View WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY quantity DESC

SELECT i.ticker AS symbol, pv.quantity, pv.average_price, pv.market_value, pv.unrealized_pnl_value FROM Positions_View pv JOIN Instruments i ON i.ticker = pv.symbol WHERE pv.account_id = #{accountId} AND pv.symbol = #{symbol}
